title: Florida Keys Tiki Boat Tour Adventure
includes: Flip N' Float rafts for swimming
Radio to stream music of your choice
Yeti Cooler with ice and bottled water
BYOB - WE DO NOT SELL DRINKS (not included)
Bring a towel and sunscreen (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a lively 1.5-hour Tiki Fun Cruise through the stunning Florida Keys. Glide over crystal-clear waters on an authentic tiki bar boat, where you can savor your favorite drinks while soaking up the sun. Keep your eyes peeled for dolphins, sea turtles, and vibrant seabirds as your knowledgeable captain shares insider secrets and local history of the Keys. Choose between a picturesque scenic harbor cruise or a refreshing swim stop at a beautiful sandy beach. This tour promises to be a memorable highlight of your Florida adventure.

- 1.5-hour cruise on a unique tiki bar boat
- Spot dolphins, turtles, and seabirds in their natural habitat
- Learn local history and fun facts from your captain
- Choose between a scenic cruise or a swim stop at the beach
